english.title: Show flashing images with intent to harm an individual
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, showed to an individual, namely **(..SPECIFY INDIVIDUAL..), flashing images by means of an electronic communications device, knowing or suspecting that individual to be an individual with epilepsy and intending that that individual would suffer harm as a result of viewing the flashing images
english.legislation: Contrary to section 183(8) and (10) of the Online Safety Act 2023.

english.notes:
(i) For the offence applicable to 'condition 1' see H101563 where the person sending a communication reasonably forsees, that another individual with epilepsy would be among the persons who would view the communication and the communication is sent with the intention that such an individual will suffer harm as a result of viewing the flashing images.
(ii) For the offence applicable to 'condition 2' see H101564 where the person sending a communication believes that an individual whom the sender knows or suspects to be an individual with epilepsy will, or might, view it and intends that individual to suffer harm as a result of viewing the flashing images.
(iii) Section 185 of the Online Safety Act 2023 provides extra-territorial application and jurisdiction for this offence.
